data.name: Disco Bear
data.detailed_description:
Disco Bear – Your Funky, Endless Groove Adventure

Step into the spotlight and feel the rhythm!
In Disco Bear, you’ll tap, dance, and shine your way through a nonstop party of lights, music, and joy. Watch your disco empire grow as your bear brings happiness to every beat. From tiny dance floors to glowing galaxies, the groove never ends.

Features:

💃 Tap & Dance – Every click fills the floor with rhythm, lights, and energy.
✨ Upgrade Your Style – Unlock outfits, stages, and special effects that sparkle with personality.
🎶 Feel the Beat – Enjoy cheerful music, vibrant visuals, and the thrill of endless disco fun.
🌈 Grow Your Groove – Expand your disco world and spread happiness with every move.
♾ Endless Fun – Relax, tap, and watch your bear shine brighter every time you play.

Whether you want to unwind with cozy beats or chase high scores in style, Disco Bear is pure, radiant joy you’ll keep coming back to.
